detail: HTTP 403 on media_publish: code 4, subcode 2207051, "action is blocked" (seen on the 2026-08-23 and 2026-08-24 daily runs)
_comment: Written by publish.py when Instagram action-blocks the account. Deleted automatically on the next successful publish. While present, publish attempts pause until cooldown_until and the DM responder stays quiet. Appealing in the app (profile -> menu -> Account Status) is the only thing that lifts a block faster.
